usedFor: Shopify holds paid orders and snapADDY holds contact lists, so “Order Paid” can add a buyer through “Create Contact Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Contact Item” in snapADDY
bestTemplate.why: A paid order carries a real customer, and the action adds them to a chosen contact list.

watchOut: “Update contact” changes an existing contact in the list, so use it instead of “Create Contact Item” for repeat buyers.
